The '''smuggler's trenchcoat''' was a [[Jacket/Legends|coat]] covered with pockets, minor compartments, and pouches within pouches to confound any search. Some [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], took the tact that if they simply had enough hidden compartments, at least a few would go unsearched. It was priced at 1,650 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Fly" />
